image_description: A close-up, slightly angled shot of a laminated restaurant menu. The menu features a beige background with red and black text in both English and Chinese. It is divided into sections such as 'Chicken', 'Beef', and 'Pork', each accompanied by small, rectangular photographs of the corresponding dishes. A pair of wooden chopsticks rests on a black holder in the bottom left foreground, partially obscuring the lower edge of the menu.
